sources.title: V8 Engine Internals and Event Loop Mechanics

chapters.title: Introduction to Execution Context and Call Stack
chapters.text: Technically bolo toh execution context is created whenever any function is invoked. Call Stack manages active frames.

chapters.title: Microtasks vs Macrotasks in Event Loop
chapters.text: Dhayan se samjho: Microtask Queue empties completely before the next macrotask executes.

chapters.title: Event Loop Tick Phases
chapters.text: The event loop has distinct phases: timers, pending callbacks, idle/prepare, poll, check, and close callbacks.

chapters.title: V8 Compilation Pipeline
chapters.text: Ignition interpreter produces bytecode from AST, while TurboFan performs JIT optimization.
